name: desk-lifecycle
description: Validate, launch, and verify the 24/7 geometric agentic desk. Gated: a failing validation step halts the pipeline before anything launches.

steps.name: compile
steps.task: Byte-compile every module to catch syntax/import errors

steps.name: test
steps.task: Run the unit test suite (math, geometry, exam)

steps.name: selftest
steps.task: Offline end-to-end pipeline self-test (no broker, no orders)

steps.name: launch
steps.task: Start the detached watchdog supervising all four agents

steps.name: verify
steps.task: Confirm agents publish to the bus and the dashboard is live

steps.name: report
steps.task: Generate the transparency report (architecture + exam table)
